signature: SUBROUTINE ZGEHD2( N, ILO, IHI, A, LDA, TAU, WORK, INFO )

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: ihi
params.reference: It is assumed that A is already upper triangular in rows and columns 1:`ILO`-1 and `IHI`+1:N. `ILO` and `IHI` are normally set by a previous call to ZGEBAL; otherwise they should be set to 1 and N respectively. See Further Details. $1 \le \mathrm{ILO} \le \mathrm{IHI} \le \max (1,N)$.

params.name: A
params.reference: On entry, the n by n general matrix to be reduced. On exit, the upper triangle and the first subdiagonal of A are overwritten with the upper Hessenberg matrix H, and the elements below the first subdiagonal, with the array `TAU`, represent the unitary matrix Q as a product of elementary reflectors. See Further Details.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (1,N)$.

params.name: TAU
params.reference: The scalar factors of the elementary reflectors (see Further Details).

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value.

checks.js: ihi < min( ilo, N ) || ihi > N
